// Generated by the comptime compiler plugin. Compiled together with the blocks of one job.
package comptimegen.enc

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream

/** A value doesn't match the call's declared type. The host reports it as a type mismatch. */
class ComptimeTypeMismatch(message: String) : RuntimeException(message)

private const val T_NULL = 0
private const val T_BOOL = 1
private const val T_BYTE = 2
private const val T_SHORT = 3
private const val T_INT = 4
private const val T_LONG = 5
private const val T_FLOAT = 6
private const val T_DOUBLE = 7
private const val T_CHAR = 8
private const val T_STRING = 9
private const val T_UBYTE = 10
private const val T_USHORT = 11
private const val T_UINT = 12
private const val T_ULONG = 13
private const val T_LIST = 14
private const val T_SET = 15
private const val T_MAP = 16
private const val T_ARRAY = 17
private const val T_PRIMITIVE_ARRAY = 18
private const val T_UNIT = 19

private class Desc(val kind: Char, val nullable: Boolean, val args: List<Desc>) {
    fun render(): String {
        val base = when (kind) {
            'Z' -> "Boolean"; 'B' -> "Byte"; 'S' -> "Short"; 'I' -> "Int"; 'J' -> "Long"
            'F' -> "Float"; 'D' -> "Double"; 'C' -> "Char"; 'T' -> "String"; 'V' -> "Unit"
            'b' -> "UByte"; 's' -> "UShort"; 'i' -> "UInt"; 'j' -> "ULong"
            'L' -> "List<${args[0].render()}>"
            'E' -> "Set<${args[0].render()}>"
            'M' -> "Map<${args[0].render()}, ${args[1].render()}>"
            'A' -> "Array<${args[0].render()}>"
            '[' -> args[0].render() + "Array"
            else -> "?"
        }
        return if (nullable) "$base?" else base
    }
}

private fun parse(s: String): Desc {
    var i = 0
    fun next(): Desc {
        val nullable = s[i] == '?'
        if (nullable) i++
        val kind = s[i++]
        val args = when (kind) {
            'L', 'E', 'A' -> listOf(next())
            'M' -> listOf(next(), next())
            '[' -> listOf(Desc(s[i++], false, emptyList()))
            else -> emptyList()
        }
        return Desc(kind, nullable, args)
    }
    val d = next()
    check(i == s.length) { "bad descriptor $s" }
    return d
}

/** Encodes [value] as the tagged tree described in docs/plan.md, checking it against [descriptor] on the way. */
fun encode(descriptor: String, value: Any?): ByteArray {
    val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream()
    val out = DataOutputStream(bytes)
    write(out, parse(descriptor), value, "")
    out.flush()
    return bytes.toByteArray()
}

private fun mismatch(path: String, d: Desc, value: Any?): Nothing {
    val actual = if (value == null) "null" else value.javaClass.name
    val at = if (path.isEmpty()) "" else " at $path"
    throw ComptimeTypeMismatch("value$at doesn't match ${d.render()}: got $actual")
}

private fun keyText(key: Any?): String = when (key) {
    is String -> "\"" + key.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\""
    else -> key.toString()
}

private fun write(out: DataOutputStream, d: Desc, value: Any?, path: String) {
    if (value == null) {
        if (!d.nullable) mismatch(path, d, null)
        out.writeByte(T_NULL)
        return
    }
    when (d.kind) {
        'Z' -> { if (value !is Boolean) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_BOOL); out.writeBoolean(value) }
        'B' -> { if (value !is Byte) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_BYTE); out.writeByte(value.toInt()) }
        'S' -> { if (value !is Short) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_SHORT); out.writeShort(value.toInt()) }
        'I' -> { if (value !is Int) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_INT); out.writeInt(value) }
        'J' -> { if (value !is Long) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_LONG); out.writeLong(value) }
        'F' -> { if (value !is Float) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_FLOAT); out.writeInt(value.toRawBits()) }
        'D' -> { if (value !is Double) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_DOUBLE); out.writeLong(value.toRawBits()) }
        'C' -> { if (value !is Char) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_CHAR); out.writeChar(value.code) }
        'T' -> {
            if (value !is String) mismatch(path, d, value)
            out.writeByte(T_STRING)
            out.writeInt(value.length)
            out.writeChars(value)
        }
        'b' -> { if (value !is UByte) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_UBYTE); out.writeByte(value.toInt()) }
        's' -> { if (value !is UShort) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_USHORT); out.writeShort(value.toInt()) }
        'i' -> { if (value !is UInt) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_UINT); out.writeInt(value.toInt()) }
        'j' -> { if (value !is ULong) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_ULONG); out.writeLong(value.toLong()) }
        'V' -> { if (value !is Unit) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeByte(T_UNIT) }
        'L' -> {
            if (value !is List<*>) mismatch(path, d, value)
            out.writeByte(T_LIST)
            out.writeInt(value.size)
            value.forEachIndexed { i, e -> write(out, d.args[0], e, "$path[$i]") }
        }
        'E' -> {
            if (value !is Set<*>) mismatch(path, d, value)
            out.writeByte(T_SET)
            out.writeInt(value.size)
            value.forEachIndexed { i, e -> write(out, d.args[0], e, "$path[$i]") }
        }
        'M' -> {
            if (value !is Map<*, *>) mismatch(path, d, value)
            out.writeByte(T_MAP)
            out.writeInt(value.size)
            var i = 0
            for ((k, v) in value) {
                write(out, d.args[0], k, "$path.keys[$i]")
                write(out, d.args[1], v, "$path[${keyText(k)}]")
                i++
            }
        }
        'A' -> {
            if (value !is Array<*>) mismatch(path, d, value)
            out.writeByte(T_ARRAY)
            out.writeInt(value.size)
            value.forEachIndexed { i, e -> write(out, d.args[0], e, "$path[$i]") }
        }
        '[' -> {
            val element = d.args[0].kind
            out.writeByte(T_PRIMITIVE_ARRAY)
            out.writeByte(element.code)
            when (element) {
                'Z' -> { if (value !is BooleanArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); value.forEach { out.writeBoolean(it) } }
                'B' -> { if (value !is ByteArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); out.write(value) }
                'S' -> { if (value !is ShortArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); value.forEach { out.writeShort(it.toInt()) } }
                'I' -> { if (value !is IntArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); value.forEach { out.writeInt(it) } }
                'J' -> { if (value !is LongArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); value.forEach { out.writeLong(it) } }
                'F' -> { if (value !is FloatArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); value.forEach { out.writeInt(it.toRawBits()) } }
                'D' -> { if (value !is DoubleArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); value.forEach { out.writeLong(it.toRawBits()) } }
                'C' -> { if (value !is CharArray) mismatch(path, d, value); out.writeInt(value.size); value.forEach { out.writeChar(it.code) } }
                else -> error("bad primitive array descriptor")
            }
        }
        else -> error("bad descriptor kind ${d.kind}")
    }
}
